''Atropis'' Trinius }} '''''Puccinellia''''' is a genus of plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]], known as '''alkali grass''' or '''salt grass'''.[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/6085825#page/368/mode/1up Parlatore, Filippo. 1848. Flora italiana; ossia, Descrizione delle piante che crescono spontanee o vegetano come tali in Italia e nelle isole ad essa aggiacenti 1: 366-371] descriptions in Latin, commentary in Italian[https://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Puccinellia Altervista Flora Italiana genere Puccinellia] includes photos and distribution maps for several species[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=127609 Flora of China 碱茅属 jian mao shu ''Puccinellia'' Parlatore, Fl. Ital. 1: 366. 1848. ][http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=5&taxon_id=127609 Flora of Pakistan][https://bonap.net/NAPA/TaxonMaps/Genus/County/Puccinellia Biota of North America Program 2013 county distribution maps] These grasses grow in wet environments, often in [[Saline water|saline]] or [[alkali]]ne conditions.
